o1: Predicted to enable ligand-gated sodium channel activity. Enables the amiloride-sensitive sodium channel activity. Involved in locomotion; muscle contraction; and sodium ion transmembrane transport. Located in neuronal cell body. Is expressed in neurons, including motor neurons, and in body wall muscle. Predicted to be part of the eicosanoid second-messenger system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Liddle syndrome; bronchiectasis 1; bronchiectasis 3; and pseudohypoaldosteronism. Orthologous to human SCNN1B (sodium channel epithelial 1 subunit beta); SCNN1D (sodium channel epithelial 1 subunit delta); and SCNN1G (sodium channel epithelial 1 subunit gamma). sup-42(lb88) ameliorates the uncoordinated phenotype; sup-43(lb141) ameliorates the uncoordinated phenotype; enu-2(lb140) exacerbates the uncoordinated phenotype.
